title: Major Explosion
blurb: Low boom, then a tail that runs for several seconds with enough bottom end to move a subwoofer. Explosion foley is almost never a real explosion; the rumble that sells it is usually layered up from sources with nothing to do with combustion at all. What matters when you are cutting is the shape: one hard transient, then a decay you can either trim into or let ring out. Meme edits treat it as the loudest available full stop, normally over a still image. Check your levels before you send this to anybody.
origin: A generic explosion sound effect, widely used in video editing.
